comments: Approved per Nitin Saini's instruction to proceed with the recommendation and preserve the reasons for traceability. TS-EC-11358-006 and TS-EC-11358-007 are deferred because both APIs return acknowledgments rather than report content, the generated-report retrieval route is not established, NSOrg has no safe Authorized/Verification package fixture, and creating an irreversible fixture is prohibited. The six approved UI scenarios proceed; the API coverage gap remains explicit.

itemDecisions.comment: Transferred financial asset shows the Control History table (AC-001).
Each row shows transfer date and both organizations (AC-002).
No confirmed transfer shows no Control History table (AC-003).
Multiple transfers are ordered newest to oldest (AC-004).
The UI view remains authoritative executable coverage for AC-005.

eoRequestExport returns batch metadata rather than report content. Package inspection requires an Authorized/Verification fixture; NSOrg currently has none, and automation must not create an irreversible fixture.
The successful API response is an api.xml status acknowledgment with no report content, report identifier, redirect, or authoritative retrieval route.
Document type determines whether the Control History table is produced (AC-006).
